correctness.rationale: The proof reconstructs the Parry return-loop probabilities and stationary unit-time length-biased suspension; exact first-entrance cylinder conditioning yields two probabilities and their negative difference; the Perron equation gives the closed form. Exhaustive rational row-space reduction for 2^5 word variables establishes reversibility at lengths <=4 and the entire one-dimensional length-five antisymmetric table. Eight nonzero unordered pairs give TV=8|delta|. The identity (lambda-2)(lambda+1)=-2 lambda^{-(n-1)} and geometric-series domination prove 2^n TV->1/6. A standalone included exact rational verifier replays 434 word checks, the small finite algebra, and 10 high-precision identities. Finite checks alone are never used to justify the infinite limit.

value.rationale: The least observable word length detecting a time arrow is a canonical, interpretable symbolic invariant under stationary sampling. The established shortening-random-beta family has a distinguished maximal-entropy stationary state and explicitly coded return paths; detecting asymmetry first at length five rather than four is structurally nonobvious. The complete signed five-block table, exact total-variation norm, and sharp exponential parameter suppression give a precise information-loss law, rather than an arbitrary isolated cylinder or routine checksum. They isolate what is and is not observable from short digit trajectories; the theorem is rigorously restricted to that natural process.
